text: Hello, namaste! Main actually ek issue ke baare mein call kar raha hoon. Maine ek crockery set order kiya tha, jiska amount Rs 2,199 tha, aur uska delivery status mujhe check karwana hai. Delivery person ne mujhe jo box diya, woh visibly crushed tha aur andar se glass ya ceramic tootne ki awaz aa rahi thi. Maine opening se pehle photos bhi click kar liye hain.
